purpose: First-stage offline leakage investigation; no second-stage classifier, inference or production changes.
poolSnapshot: Original 1503-row holdout-excluded public cache snapshot from 2026-09-05, same canonical hash as manifest.json. No new holdout access.
sampling: Stratified SHA256(seed|id) ordering: 70 no-family survivors, 35 title-veto survivors, all 22 duty-veto and all 9 insufficient-body survivors; 60 of 130 baseline rejects. Each row carries N/n design weight.
review: Coding-assistant editorial title/duties review. Not human ground truth; ambiguity stays KEEP. Labels fixed before refinement scores for the initial audit. Delta audit follows scoring and is a development safety census, not independent validation.
deltaSelection: All 41 newly rejected procurement-context records outside the initial audit, reviewed exhaustively; selected using candidate predictions, never used for prevalence estimation.
labelPolicy: Same conservative technical/adjacent engineering scope. Explicit civil construction design is outside; uncertain electrical/mechanical engineering, technical integration/presales/support survive. Old frozen labels are unchanged; audit flags the General Finance disagreement.
limitations: Development/audit overlap and post-result refinement prohibit independent generalization claims.
Real cache snapshot is employer-specific, not all future arrivals.
Binomial intervals for reviewed reject risk describe sampling uncertainty only, not label correctness or model-selection uncertainty.
